rationale: The last five 5-minute candles show extremely thin participation (188–1,049 shares each), with price effectively pinned at the day's high on negligible activity — this is not a breakout with volume confirmation but rather illiquid price drift. The bid-ask spread of 54.7 bps combined with a tiny float and no news catalyst means the cost of entry and exit alone erodes any realistic edge, and the lack of any directional momentum structure (candles are single-price prints, not genuine discovery) makes both long continuation and short fade unreliable theses.
